_meta.description: Weighted symptom-disease knowledge base for the rule-based diagnostic engine. Each condition lists symptoms mapped to a weight in the range 0..1 representing how strongly that symptom indicates the condition. This is a curated, EDUCATIONAL rule set and is NOT clinically validated. It must be reviewed and validated against recognised medical references before any real-world use.

conditions.name: Malaria
conditions.description: A mosquito-borne infectious disease causing cyclical fever, chills, and flu-like illness.

conditions.name: Common Cold
conditions.description: A mild viral infection of the nose and throat.

conditions.name: Influenza (Flu)
conditions.description: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses, more severe than a common cold.

conditions.name: COVID-19
conditions.description: A respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, ranging from mild to severe.

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: A neurological condition causing recurrent, often severe headaches.

conditions.name: Gastroenteritis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines, typically from infection ('stomach flu').

conditions.name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
conditions.description: Persistently elevated blood pressure, often without obvious symptoms but sometimes presenting with headaches or dizziness.

conditions.name: Asthma
conditions.description: A chronic condition in which the airways narrow and swell, causing breathing difficulty.

conditions.name: Allergic Rhinitis (Hay Fever)
conditions.description: An allergic response causing sneezing, congestion, and itchy eyes.

conditions.name: Pneumonia
conditions.description: Infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs.

conditions.name: Urinary Tract Infection
conditions.description: An infection in any part of the urinary system, most often the bladder.

conditions.name: Tonsillitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the tonsils, usually due to viral or bacterial infection.

conditions.name: Dengue Fever
conditions.description: A mosquito-borne viral infection causing high fever and severe body aches.

conditions.name: Typhoid Fever
conditions.description: A bacterial infection spread through contaminated food and water.

conditions.name: Conjunctivitis (Pink Eye)
conditions.description: Inflammation of the conjunctiva causing red, itchy, watery eyes.
